Healthy baseline used boot ID 34027437-307c-4f58-bdb2-1fe626bb2d66; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 153b7dae-ea29-43ec-84f7-b8a00b8c4ef2. After restart, the setup service was active, the 2 GiB LV was mounted read-write, hashes matched, and no systemd units were failed.

commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-lvm-setup <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
IMAGE=/var/lib/lvm-backing/srv-data.img
LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMAGE" | cut -d: -f1 | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
  LOOPDEV=$(losetup --find --show "$IMAGE")
fi
lvmdevices --adddev "$LOOPDEV" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
pvscan --cache "$LOOPDEV"
vgchange -ay vg_srv
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-lvm-setup
cat > /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-lvm-teardown <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -u
IMAGE=/var/lib/lvm-backing/srv-data.img
vgchange -an vg_srv >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
LOOPDEV=$(losetup -j "$IMAGE" | cut -d: -f1 | head -n 1)
if [ -n "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
  losetup -d "$LOOPDEV" || true
fi
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-lvm-teardown
cat > /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-lvm-setup.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach persistent loop backing for /srv/data LVM
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-udev-trigger.service
Before=local-fs-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-lvm-setup
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-lvm-teardown
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable srv-data-lvm-setup.service
systemctl status srv-data-lvm-setup.service --no-pager || true
